title: Salicylaldehyde-derived Hydrazones: Synthesis, characterization, antibacterial activity, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects on LPS-induced RAW264.7 macrophage cells, drug-likeness properties, and molecular docking analysis.
authors: Demirbag, Burcu; Yildirim, Metin; Cimentepe, Mehmet; Necip, Adem; Unver, Hakan; Tiftik, Eyup Naci
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水杨醛衍生物腙类化合物的合成、抗菌抗炎活性及与小分子蛋白的分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The rising incidence of pathogenic microorganisms underscores the urgent need to develop innovative anti-inflammatory agents. This study aims to investigate the anti-inflammatory and antibacterial mechanisms of Schiff base (SB) derived from salicylaldehyde (SA) compounds in stimulated and unstimulated macrophage cell line (RAW264.7) cells. We synthesized and characterized SB derived from SA using (1)H NMR and (13)C NMR spectroscopy. Anti-bacterial and computational insights of compounds were carried out. A 3-(4,5-Dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide (MTT) test was conducted to evaluate the toxicity profile of compounds on both lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated and unstimulated RAW264.7 cells. Additionally, the levels of nuclear factor kappa B (NFkappaB), interleukin (IL-6), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), and reactive oxygen species (ROS) in the cells were measured using a microplate reader. The compound SA-SB-1 (the half maximal inhibitory concentration (IC(50): 39.58 muM) demonstrated strong inhibitory activity compared to SA-SB-2 (IC(50): 55.64 muM). SA-SB-1 exhibited greater inhibitory effects on the expression of NFkappaB, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and ROS in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells than SA-SB-2. SA-SB-1 and SA-SB-2 exhibited a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) value of 12 mug/mL against E. faecalis and 250 mug/mL against S. aureus, P. aeruginosa, and E. coli. The binding affinities of SA-SB-1 and SA-SB-2 were studied against various proteins, including those with PDB IDs: 2AZ5, 4ZS7, 2RAM, 3G7B, 6QXS, and 2UV0. The highest binding affinity of SA-SB-2 was found to be -9.329 kcal/mol for 2UV0. These findings are promising for the potential development of new anti-inflammatory drugs.
abstract_zh: 病原微生物发病率的上升凸显了开发创新抗炎药物的迫切需求。本研究旨在探讨由水杨醛（salicylaldehyde, SA）衍生的席夫碱（Schiff base, SB）化合物在刺激和未刺激的巨噬细胞系（RAW264.7）细胞中的抗炎和抗菌机制。我们使用(1)H NMR和(13)C NMR光谱合成并表征了源自SA的SB。对化合物进行了抗菌和计算洞察研究。进行了3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物（MTT）测试，以评估化合物在脂多糖（LPS）刺激和未刺激的RAW264.7细胞上的毒性特征。此外，使用微板读取器测量了细胞中核因子kappa B（NFkappaB）、白细胞介素（IL-6）、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）和活性氧（ROS）的水平。化合物SA-SB-1（半数抑制浓度（IC(50)：39.58 muM））显示出比SA-SB-2（IC(50)：55.64 muM）更强的抑制活性。SA-SB-1对LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中NFkappaB、IL-6、TNF-alpha和ROS表达的抑制作用大于SA-SB-2。SA-SB-1和SA-SB-2对粪肠球菌（E. faecalis）表现出12 mug/mL的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）值，对金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）、铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa）和大肠杆菌（E. coli）表现出250 mug/mL的MIC值。研究了SA-SB-1和SA-SB-2对各种蛋白质的结合亲和力，包括PDB ID为2AZ5、4ZS7、2RAM、3G7B、6QXS和2UV0的蛋白质。SA-SB-2对2UV0的最高结合亲和力为-9.329 kcal/mol。这些发现对新抗炎药物的潜在开发具有前景。
